verdict.rationale: LlamaParse ships versioned APIs. Parse has distinct v1 and v2 with a documented v1-to-v2 migration guide, calls accept a version parameter, and the SDK packages carry migration notices. However, no formal deprecation policy (notice periods, sunset timelines, support windows) appears in the evidence. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy with timelines/notice guarantees, API versioning semantics documentation, independent corroboration of upgrade experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: For new integrations, use Parse v2. See the v1 to v2 migration guide to update existing v1 code.
Please migrate to the new packages: - **Python**: `pip install llama-cloud>=1.0`
